latest_release.name: Release v0.31.5
latest_release.body:
###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- **ci**:
  - 发布链 Rust 工具链钉到 1.98.1  -  by @hairyf in https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/issues/1529 [<samp>(da13d)</samp>](https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/commit/da13dbcc)
- **core**:
  - Stage the pinned release before switching formats  -  by @SkanderBog in https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/issues/1519 [<samp>(ac593)</samp>](https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/commit/ac593b45)
- **desktop**:
  - Update dsh-tauri-desk references to dsh-tauri and relax github timeout  -  by @eacheat53 in https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/issues/1507 [<samp>(ff5e4)</samp>](https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/commit/ff5e4815)
  - Preserve the terminal startup error  -  by @SkanderBog in https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/issues/1518 [<samp>(0fe58)</samp>](https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/commit/0fe58089)
- **updater**:
  - Recover release lookup and verify cached installers  -  by @SkanderBog in https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/issues/1520 [<samp>(26bfd)</samp>](https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/commit/26bfd1bf)

#####     [View changes on GitHub](https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/compare/v0.31.4...v0.31.5)

### 📦 Artifacts
- **macOS (Apple Silicon)**: 下载 `aarch64.dmg`
- **macOS (Intel)**: 下载 `x64.dmg`
- **Windows (x64)**: 下载 `_x64-setup.exe`
- **Windows (ARM64)**: 下载 `_arm64-setup.exe`
- **Linux (x64)**: 下载 `.AppImage` 或 `.deb`（基于 Ubuntu 22.04 构建）
- **Linux (ARM64)**: 下载 `aarch64.AppImage` 或 `arm64.deb`（基于 Ubuntu 22.04 构建，GLIBC 符号上限 2.35）
- **Android**: 桌面端发布后追加 `.apk`；未配置签名密钥时使用开发证书，仅供评估
- **iOS（Testflight）**: 打开 [TestFlight 邀请链接](https://testflight.apple.com/join/kYXkpnp1)，通过 beta 测试安装
- **iOS（IPA）**: 桌面端发布后追加 `_unsigned.ipa`；需自行签名，不能直接安装

> 文件名带 `_Bundle` 后缀的是**离线捆绑包**：安装包里已内置 Node.js 运行时、pnpm
> 与打包好的 dsh 内核，首次启动无需联网即可直接运行。不带该后缀的是常规安装包，
> 首次启动时按需下载运行时依赖。
